newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Dhaka stocks close up as rally continues.
newsitem.headline: Dhaka stocks close up as rally continues.

text.p: The Dhaka bourse closed higher after most shares gained on optimistic investor expectations ahead of the annual meetings of several companies, brokers said.
The Dhaka Stock Exchange (DSE) all share price index rose 59.74 points or 1.67 percent at 3,627.01. Turnover was 595.7 million taka. Of the 125 traded issues, 78 gained and 46 lost.
Shine Pukur Holdings was the volume leader with 209,250 shares traded at 591.84 taka, up 27.63 taka from the previous close.
Chittagong Cement rose 2,047.04 taka to 15,693 in the wake of its announcement of offering rights share and bonus on Thursday.
